{{Quote|Bzzt&hellip;Snap&hellip;Bzzz&hellip;Braczt&hellip;"<br />"Jinkins, if you hit another nerve ending, I'm gonna take that fusion cutter to your skull!|The sounds made by the hand cannon's construction, and Nym's frustration with Jinkins' craftsmanship|<ref name="Starfighter: Crossbones 3">[[Starfighter: Crossbones 3|''Starfighter: Crossbones'' 3]]</ref>}}
In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Jinkins]] cobbled together a powerful, albeit short-lived, '''hand cannon''' for his [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]. Jinkins then installed the cannon in place of Nym's destroyed [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]] arm, which had been eaten by a [[relix]]. This allowed Nym, who chose the weapon over a giant hook being affixed to his arm, to fire the cannon at will. Made from an assortment of spare parts and weapons found on the [[Boat/Legends|sea cutter]] ''[[Sunrunner]]'', it fired bursts of explosive ammunition. [[Kole]], Nym's first mate, referred to it as Nym's and Jinkin's "science project." The weapon proved effective against [[Sol Sixxa]]'s [[Mere]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] until Sixxa severed it with his [[Sword/Legends|sword]], causing Nym much physical pain. It was later replaced by a more conventional metal hand.
